title: search_logs arguments (server "exec", tool "search_logs")
description: The arguments of mcp-exec's search_logs tool (SearchLogsRequest): the lines of a command's output that match a regular expression. It starts nothing.

id.description: The execution's UUID, as exec returned it.

pattern.description: A regular expression in the syntax of Rust's regex crate (no backtracking, so no expression is expensive to match).
